text: Suit integrity, sixty-one percent. Primary systems offline.
Emergency mode active. Technically, you are still operational.
Depth, two thousand meters. We landed several kilometers off the designated dock.
This area is an abandoned company complex. Environment, hostile.
Survival probability, zero point zero zero one percent. I rounded up.
Oxygen reserve is limited. Nearest company structure, a lock gate. South, down the canyon.
Bioluminescent fauna ahead. Artificial light at this depth works like a dinner bell.
Watch how they react to your light. Then decide how bright you want to be.
Company stations run on standard energy cells. Find one. Plug it in.
Red light module installed. Most local fauna cannot see red.
H.E.L.M. online. Hazard and Environment Linked Monitor. Your suit assistant.
Nuclear energy cell. It flares when it moves. Carry it gently.
It is also radioactive. Do not sleep next to it.
Power restored. Stand close to the station to refill your oxygen.
The gate has an optical sensor. It is waiting for a specific light.
Optical sensor, accepted. Lock gate opening.
